```rust
use proc_macro2::TokenStream;
use syn::visit_mut::{self, VisitMut};
use syn::{File, Ident, Item};

pub fn parse_file(src: &str) -> syn::Result<File> {
    syn::parse_file(src)
}

pub fn parse_item(tokens: TokenStream) -> syn::Result<Item> {
    syn::parse2(tokens)
}

pub fn parse_tokens<T: syn::parse::Parse>(tokens: TokenStream) -> syn::Result<T> {
    syn::parse2(tokens)
}

struct Renamer<'a> { from: &'a str, to: &'a Ident }
impl VisitMut for Renamer<'_> {
    fn visit_ident_mut(&mut self, ident: &mut Ident) {
        if ident == self.from {
            *ident = self.to.clone();
        }
        visit_mut::visit_ident_mut(self, ident);
    }
}

pub fn rename_ident(item: &mut Item, from: &str, to: &str) {
    let mut v = Renamer { from, to: &Ident::new(to, proc_macro2::Span::call_site()) };
    v.visit_item_mut(item);
}

pub fn to_tokens(item: &Item) -> TokenStream {
    quote::quote!(#item)
}
```

```
Cargo.toml                      # workspace, resolver 3, edition 2024
crates/ast-core/                # normal lib: parse + transform logic (testable)
  src/lib.rs                    # parse_file/parse_item/parse_tokens, rename_ident via VisitMut
crates/ast-macros/              # proc-macro = true, thin wrapper
  src/lib.rs                    # #[ast_rename(from, to)] attribute macro
  tests/rename.rs               # integration test exercising the macro
```

Key choices:
- **Split crate layout** so logic lives in `ast-core` and is unit-testable; `ast-macros` only exports the proc macro (proc-macro crates can't export normal items).
- **`syn` v2** with `full`, `extra-traits`, `visit-mut` for parsing/inspection/recursive rewriting; `quote`/`proc-macro2` for emission.

`ast-core/src/lib.rs:9` is the parse entry point; `rename_ident` at `ast-core/src/lib.rs:26` is the `VisitMut`-based transform used by `ast-macros/src/lib.rs:38`.

One caveat worth knowing: the visitor walks real AST nodes, so identifiers inside macro invocation token streams (e.g. `assert_eq!(value, …)`) are opaque and not renamed.
